Benchopt is a collaborative framework for creating reproducible benchmarks of
optimization algorithms in machine learning. It automates the tedious work of
implementing, running, and comparing different solvers across programming
languages and hardware, ensuring that benchmarks are transparent and can be
easily extended by the community.

The framework handles the complexity of fair comparison---managing dependencies,
standardizing interfaces, and collecting performance metrics---so researchers
can focus on understanding which methods work best for their problems.
Benchmarks cover standard ML tasks like logistic regression, LASSO, and neural
network training, providing practical insights beyond theoretical comparisons.
